policy_compliance_status: Nkwenye: Ụlọ Ahịa Play 2026 Dị Njikere
policy_privacy_intro_p1: Nnọọ na Da-Costa. Anyị gbara mbọ ichekwa nzuzo gị mgbe anyị na-enye nchekwa cybersecurity dị elu. Amụma a na-akọwapụta ụzọ anyị si eme 'Nzuzo-Mbụ' maka nhazi data, ọkachasị maka atụmatụ Unified Security Service Edge (SSE) anyị.
policy_privacy_email_p1: "Ngwa Da-Costa na-enye nchedo ozugbo megide Mmekọrịta Azụmaahịa Email (BEC) na injinia mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya site na 'Nyocha Ụda Email & Mmepụta Onwe' anyị."
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: Iji chọpụta mmepụta onwe onye, ngwa ahụ na-enyocha okwu, syntax, na ụda ozi-e na-abata. A na-eme nyocha a site na iji AI enweghị steeti.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: Anyị anaghị echekwa ahụ ozi-e gị. Ngwa ahụ na-echekwa naanị 'Mbinye aka Ụda' (ihe ngosi mgbakọ na mwepụ nke ụdị onye zitere) na mpaghara na ngwaọrụ gị iji tulee ozi ndị na-abata n'ọdịnihu.
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Ọdịnaya email gị anaghị ebugo na sava anyị. A na-ahazi ya na steeti na-agafe agafe iji wepụta akara ihe egwu nchekwa ma hichapụ ya ozugbo nyocha ahụ gasịrị.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: Ị nwere ike kwụpụ nlekota email ma ọ bụ hichapụ cache 'Mbinye aka Ụda' mpaghara gị n'oge ọ bụla site na ntọala Data & Nzuzo.
policy_privacy_guarantee1_desc: Anyị anaghị erere ndị ọzọ data gị.
policy_privacy_guarantee2_desc: A naghị eji data nchekwa gị maka mgbasa ozi.
policy_privacy_guarantee3_desc: Anyị anaghị enyocha mmegharị gị ma ọ bụ ojiji ngwa maka nyocha.
policy_privacy_guarantee4_desc: Ozi nkeonwe na mgbasa ozi anaghị echekwa na igwe ojii.
policy_privacy_rights_p1: N'okpuru GDPR, NDPR, na CCPA, ị nwere ọbụbụeze zuru oke na data gị. Ị nwere ike ibupụ ndekọ nyocha gị, rịọ ka ehichapụ ya ozugbo, ma ọ bụ wepụ ikike ndabere niile site na dashboard ngwa ahụ.

firstscreen_description_line1: Ọnụ ụzọ ámá gị enweghị paswọọdụ maka nchekwa dị elu, na-eji AI dị elu na-enyocha metadata faịlụ n'oge.
firstscreen_description_line2: Enweghị asambodo echekwara. Mgbe ọ bụla.
firstscreen_stateless1_desc: Anyị na-enyocha metadata n'oge na-adịghị anya. A naghị echekwa vidiyo gị, njikọ gị, na ozi gị.
firstscreen_stateless2_desc: Nchedo na-eme ozugbo na-akwụsịghị ọrụ gị.

perimeter_active_title: Oke Arụọrụ. Ị dị Stateless Ugbu a.
perimeter_active_subtitle: Nnabata na ọkwa Da-Costa nke nzuzo dijitalụ.
perimeter_initialized_card_body: Ogige ahụ dị ugbu a. Site n'oge a, Gemini 1.5 Flash AI na-enyocha gburugburu dijitalụ gị na ozugbo.
perimeter_invisible_protection_body: Da-Costa na-arụ ọrụ n'atụghị egwu na ndabere. Ị ga-anụ naanị n'ọnụ anyị ma ọ bụrụ na ihe egwu dị elu, dị ka njikọ ọjọọ ma ọ bụ mgbalị mmepụta onwe onye, egbochiri.
perimeter_purge_body: Iji sọpụrụ nkwa anyị maka nzuzo gị, anyị ehichapụlarị metadata ntọala. Ị ga-achọpụta na ọ nweghị taabụ 'Akụkọ' ma ọ bụ 'Ndekọ'—nke a bụ site na imewe. Ọ bụrụ na anyị achọta ya, anyị na-akara ya, mgbe ahụ anyị na-echefu ya.
perimeter_stay_secure_body: Ị nwere ike nyochaa nchekwa gị n'oge ọ bụla site na ileba anya maka akara ngosi “Ọta Na-enwu ọkụ” na dashboard gị.
guide_title: Otu O Si Arụ Ọrụ: Ụkpụrụ Enweghị Ọnọdụ
guide_card1_body: Ị chọghị ịmalite nyocha. AI anyị na-enyocha ngosi ndabere na isi okwu faịlụ na-akpaghị aka.
guide_card2_body: Ọtụtụ ngwa na-echekwa data gị iji melite ọrụ ha. Anyị anaghị eme ya. Nyocha ọ bụla bụ mmalite ọhụrụ, na-ahụ na mkparịta ụka nkeonwe gị na-anọgide bụrụ nke gị naanị.
guide_card3_body: Ọ bụrụ na ịnata njikọ WhatsApp na-enyo enyo ma ọ bụ email aghụghọ, Da-Costa ga-akpalite Nkwupụta Ogige Ozugbo. Ozugbo ị chụpụrụ nkwupụta ahụ, a na-ehichapụ data metụtara ihe egwu ahụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
